Apply the 12-character minimum to invitation passwords before merge so all password validators enforce the stated security policy.

## Changes

The pull request raises the minimum password length for signup and reset from 8 to 12 characters and updates both boundary tests. It also adds `review.txt`.

## Critical

- PR body — correctness — Enforce the 12-character minimum for invitations — An eight-character invitation password passes validation despite the PR description’s stated 12-character requirement. The invitation validator still sets its minimum to 8 at `app/invite.py:1`. — Invited users can choose passwords that violate the stated security policy. — Fix: Raise the minimum in `app/invite.py:1` and update `test_password_boundaries` in `tests/test_invite.py:6`.
